risk_summary: The disclosure is heavily caveated and relies on subjective valuation, impairment, allowance, and tax assumptions, with limited quantified sensitivity analysis. Credit and asset-quality risks are evident from impaired loans, collateral dependence, fair-value volatility, foreclosure exposure, and a full deferred-tax-asset valuation allowance. The excerpt also reports recurring losses and adverse operating trends, although some year-over-year expense improvements are quantified.
